objective: Show distinct attempt, publication and displayed snapshot identities for nightly, Macro, candidates and paper, and freeze local evidence before a user-triggered readable brief trial.
non_goals: No market or model API, team permission changes, production installation, formal U4 decision, paper registration, or trading.
input_contracts: Operator-configured local source root only; no HTTP-selected filesystem path.
Public pointer and bound local artifacts are captured once, with latest attempt kept separate.
output_artifacts: Immutable snapshot, report, citations, receipt and SHA256SUMS under nonproduction state.
Module identity table and latest attempted brief with readable STOP evidence.
acceptance_tests: Different attempt/publication dates remain distinct; changed hash and contradictory run stop; missing data is not zero; output tampering fails; restart and idempotent retry preserve records.
approval_gates: Independent review before merge; production and shared deployment not included.
